svg.text: Complying in C keeps you there forever, so v_C is just the per-period profit;

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: complying in S returns you to C, so v_S carries a δ·v_C term.
